# Fixtures for the Marks wave

Written at S0 for [the plan](../../../docs/gpui/marks/PLAN.md)'s section 11, item 2. The XYplorer files are made by hand from section 7.1 (no real `tag.dat` has been seen yet: section 14, item 1), so where XYplorer's own files turn out to differ, the files and this page change with them. They are generated byte for byte (UTF-16LE, with or without a byte-order mark, `\r\n` or `\n`); edit them with a script that keeps that, never in an editor that re-encodes them.

## XYplorer's `tag.dat` (card A3)

Every file has the seven labels Red to Grey (version 3's has nine), the extra fields' definitions (sixteen lines in version 5, five in version 3; an unused one is `|0|0|0|||||`), a `Storage:` line whose words after the number are XYplorer's and not read, and its data lines.

| File | What it has | Reading it gives |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `v5-storage0-bom-crlf.dat` | Version 5, byte-order mark, `\r\n`, storage 0, four named extras (`Status` list, `Stars` rating, `Reviewed` checkbox, `Due` date) | 7 items, below |
| `v5-storage1-nobom-lf.dat` | No byte-order mark, `\n`, storage 1 (`?:\…`) | `?:\ops\bond0.conf` label 3; `?:\photos\beach.jpg` tags `summer`, `beach`, comment `sunset` and a line break |
| `v5-storage2.dat` | Storage 2: relative to XYplorer's folder | `..\..\ops\bond0.conf` label 1; `..\data\notes.md` tag `notes` |
| `XYplorerTag-storage3.dat` | Storage 3: relative to the file's own folder (what `tagexport` writes for one folder) | `bond0.conf` label 4; `sub\notes.md` comment `first`, line break, `second` |
| `v5-storage4.dat` | Storage 4: a volume's serial for the drive | `B2D60DFE:\ops\bond0.conf` label 6; `0000ABCD:\x.txt` tag `elsewhere` |
| `v3-storage0.dat` | Version 3: five extra fields, nine labels (`Work`, `Home` after Grey) | `C:\v3\old.txt` label 8 (`Work`), tags `legacy`, `v3`, extra `Topic` = `netplan`, comment `kept`, line break, `since v3`; `C:\v3\plain.txt` comment `a | b` |

`v5-storage0-bom-crlf.dat`, item by item:

| Path | Label | Tags as written | Comment as written | Why it is there |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `C:\ops\bond0.conf` | 1 (Red) | `bond, netplan` | `mode 4¶LACP rate fast` | `, ` between tags; `¶` is a line break |
| `C:\ops\pipes.txt` | 0 | `a,b` | `left \| right \|\| end` | `,` alone between tags; the comment, last, keeps its own `\|` |
| `C:\ops\review.docx` | 5 (Blue) | | | extras: `In review`, `4`, `1`, `2026-11-30`, which 7.4 makes the tags `Status: In review`, `Stars: 4`, `Reviewed` and the comment line `Due: 2026-11-30` |
| `C:\ops\past.txt` | 9 | `x` | `label 9 of 7` | a label number past the list: no label, and the preview says so |
| `C:\ops\archive` | 7 (Grey) | `old` | | a folder; *Grey* is Glint's *Gray* |
| `C:\ops\تقرير.pdf` | 2 (Orange) | `مهم, عمل` | `ملاحظة¶سطر ثان` | an Arabic name, tags and comment |
| `C:\ops\spaces.txt` | 0 | ` lead , trail ,dup, DUP` | | tags are trimmed and kept once in any case: `lead`, `trail`, `dup` |

**A file of 10,000 lines** is not here: the test makes it from these lines (about 1.4 MB of UTF-16 that would only repeat them), and checks it reads under 50 ms (6.6).

## `.glint-marks` (card A2)

| File | What it has | Reading it gives |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `later-version.glint-marks` | Version 2 in its first line, and keys this version doesn't know (`rating`, `color`, `future`) | both lines, the unknown keys kept and written back as they were |
| `leaves-folder.glint-marks` | Names with `\`, `/`, `..`, `.` and an empty one, then `ok.txt` | `ok.txt` alone; six refused (a line can only speak of an item in its own folder, by its name) |
| `cut.glint-marks` | Cut off in the middle of its last line, with no line end | `whole.txt`; one refused |
